segments.text: If you use cloud code, you need this.
You know when you're deep in a session and the AI just forgets everything?
That's context degradation. Context mode fixes it, cutting Cloud Code's context consumption by 98%. It intercepts massive tool outputs, chunks them, and only feeds the AI exactly what it needs.
Real results, 315 kilobytes shrunk to 5.4, stretching sessions from 30 minutes to nearly 3 hours. No extra API calls.
